visualReview.notes: Connected Palazzo Vecchio exterior: buff rusticated fortress block and red ceramic roof ranges, four open courts, paired arched window rhythm, projecting machicolated gallery/crenels and actual recessed entrance/threshold/treads. Torre di Arnolfo uses its mapped shaft footprint, separate static clock face/hands, projecting corbelled terrace, genuine open arched belfry with schematic hanging bell, V-notched tower merlons and original gold vane. Corrected the ownership mask for the slightly projecting tower, refined the tower merlons and framed the whole tower in the same author/inspect/fix pass. Windows, lower gallery arches and clock are exterior proxies; belfry and entrance have actual openings/recesses.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Six roles use five existing 256px shared graphs: stone_sandstone, stone_limestone_raw, tile_ceramic, storefront and metal_painted. Sandstone repeats at 1.80 x 1.50m. Painted metal supplies dark accents and gold vane. No embedded image, private atlas or new graph. One skyline draw, five textured draws; separate POSITION/NORMAL streams and equal CPU/GPU geometry bytes. Each used graph reads once per native run; unload disposes geometry.

mediumFiReview.notes: Four authored LODs 824 / 1739 / 5434 / 8110 triangles; initial skyline+district geometry 243616 bytes, closeup 772164 bytes. Six GLBs zero Khronos errors/warnings; 135 actual mesh/contact probes and 12 actual PMTiles 13/14/15 cases with five owned detailed records. Inspected 52 current portable/shared/medium-fi/native frames. Every LOD/failure/unload preserves 2698 resident / 3351 wider independent buildings, original 201x201/6m terrain/roads/243798.838m² water and four court/Piazza/approach ground openings. Failure keeps all 2703 original buildings; unload restores ground/water and zero live geometry.

fidelityReview.notes: Picture-led medium-fi exterior. Source tower height 94m and parent 17m are unqualified map controls, not survey. Working west block eave 30m, gallery to 34m/crenels to 36m, rear ranges 23m and high connecting range 28m with pitched tile roofs. Mapped tower shaft rises from the palace to 67m; projecting terrace 67..76m, open arched belfry 76..87m, crown/merlons to 92m and schematic vane to 94m. Subdivisions, roof junctions, inventories and unseen elevations are reconstructed. Main portal has a 1.4m recess, curved soffit, 0.35m threshold and short treads. Clock face/hands are static proxies; no copied numerals or coats of arms. No furnished interiors or adjacent monuments. Tower merlons have V notches at district/street/closeup; skyline reduces them to simple crenels. Crown merlons reach 90.25m; vane remains 94m. Gallery arches/windows and static clock are exterior proxies; belfry arches are genuine open geometry. Native exterior fit remains a qualified approximation: coarse ground exposes downhill foundation and leaves minor uphill burial; some low entrance treads meet the original path/ground while the portal reveal/threshold remain exposed. Four native courtyard holes are preserved through all LODs. Heights, roof junctions, inventories, unseen elevations, historic paving/stairs and accessibility remain reconstructed or unverified. No copied sculptures, shields, numerals or inscriptions, flags, furnished rooms or adjacent Loggia/Uffizi models. Physical laptop/phone and dense-city timings remain pending.

Current shared materials, hashes, vertex layout and LOD caps checked.
